full_page.content:
1945, December 8
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten message added to a Seraphic Mass Association Certificate by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Patrick H. Casey - that he learn to forgive - "Blessed are the peace-makers for they shall be called the children of God."
Feast of the Imaculate Conception 1945 God bless you - My dear Brother Patrick. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Requested by Rt. Rev. E'd. F. J. Casey - - his Brother
